description: Source code for the BridgeObject component in a WebKit-based JavaScript bridge, including functions for JS string conversion, message handling, and injecting JavaScript into web frames.

methods.name: JSStringToString
methods.description: Converts a JSStringRef to a std::string.

methods.name: JSStringToB64WKString
methods.description: Converts a JSStringRef to a base64-encoded WKStringRef.

methods.name: B64WKStringToJSString
methods.description: Decodes a base64 WKStringRef to a JSStringRef.

methods.name: OnBridgeQuery
methods.description: Handles bridge query messages from JavaScript.

methods.name: OnCreateBridgeObject
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript bridge object with a message handler.

methods.name: CallBridge
methods.description: Executes a script in the web page context to send messages.

methods.name: InjectJS
methods.description: Injects JavaScript code into a web frame to set up the bridge.

methods.name: HandleMessageToPage
methods.description: Handles messages from the web page to the native code.
